text.en:
The Negros Oriental National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Bayawan, Province of
Negros Oriental, shall offer post-secondary courses leading to the degrees of Bachelor in Agricultural
Technology and Bachelor of Science in Agriculture major in agricultural education, agricultural extension,
agricultural economics, of agro-forestry.

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports is directed to take such steps as are necessary for
the immediate implementation of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
